Subject: SOW request: Buildkite Enterprise + container-registry add-on bundling

Hi Samir / Elena —

As discussed in last week's vendor sync, Redwood is evaluating a combined procurement for our CI/CD fleet and a managed container registry add-on to simplify billing and support. High level ask below; can you turn this into a first-pass SOW + ballpark pricing? Ideally we'd get a draft by EOD Friday so procurement can start internal routing.

What we need from you:
- A short SOW draft that covers: license terms, metrics used for billing (agents, concurrent jobs, container storage), support SLAs, data residency, and an escalation path.
- A bundled price for 12 months and a 36-month option; note that we might commit to a higher agent count if registry egress/networking is included.
- Any assumptions about retention/garbage collection and recommended retention tiers for images (30/90/365).
- Integration checklist: auth (OIDC), registry credentials rotation, image signing, and CI pipelines migration plan.

Context: Redwood runs ~120 concurrent CI agents during peak, ~1.5M docker pulls/month, and currently we keep images for 90 days. We will likely enable advanced registry features (immutability, replication to eu-west) for a subset of repos.

Attachments: redwood_ci_requirements.pdf (internal requirements + expected traffic profile).

Next steps: Please reply with an SOW draft + quote and proposed dates for an architecture workshop (30–60m).

Thanks —
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Manager, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the details and the requirements doc — useful. I've looped in our contracts team (cc). Attached is an initial quote and a short SOW template tailored to Buildkite Enterprise. High level notes:

- Pricing model: annual subscription based on "concurrent agents" bands + optional add-on for hosted registry ingress/egress. We can offer a 15% list discount on the 36-month commit.
- Agent sizing: your ~120 peak maps to our 128-concurrent band. We recommend starting at the 128 band and letting autoscaling handle spikes; we can negotiate burst allowances.
- Registry: we can bundle a partner-managed registry add-on (through HarborCloud) with integrated auth. If you take both through us we can apply a 10% cross-product bundling credit.
- SLAs: 99.9% availability for controller APIs; job/runtime SLOs vary by customer workload.

Attached: BK_enterprise_quote_v1.pdf (quote + SOW).

Proposed times for architecture workshop next week (PST): Mon 8/24 09:00 or Tue 8/25 11:00. Which works for your infra team?

Hi Aisha / Samir —

Thanks for the intro. HarborCloud can support the registry add-on and handle cross-region replication + image immutability for the repos you flagged. Quick clarifications so our pricing aligns with your needs:

- Billing metric: we price based on stored GB (tiered), pulls (monthly) and replication egress (per-GB). For the bundle we can place a fixed cap on replication egress for the first 12 months to simplify forecasting.
- Retention: our managed default is 90 days; we can extend to 365 for archival repos — pricing is additive.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II scoping is available; we will provide an evidence pack for procurement.

I've attached a worksheet with three pricing scenarios (standard / enterprise / enterprise+replication). We can apply the bundle credit Samir mentioned if procurement and contracts lines up.

Proposed architecture workshop: Tue 8/25 11:00 PST (matches one of Samir's options). Please confirm.

Cheers,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partner Solutions, HarborCloud

Subject: Re: SOW request: Buildkite Enterprise + container-registry add-on bundling

Thanks for the vendor replies — quick technical notes from infra:

- Migration: we need a migration freeze window for production images and a backfill plan for tags to avoid pipeline breakage. That needs to be in the SOW.
- Auth: OIDC + short-lived tokens are required; we cannot support long-lived static credentials for critical repos.
- Retention reclaim: when you say "90 days default" we need a soft-delete window of 14 days before permanent purge. Also need immutability for our signed images.
- Network: if replication egress is capped, we need to ensure builds that pull from eu-west don't suffer increased latency — consider a CDN/edge cache.

Procurement asks for the SOW: please include migration milestones, rollback criteria, and a list of deliverables (runbook, runbook handoff session, 1 month of cutover support).

I can attend Tue 8/25 11:00 PST for the workshop.

—Dev
Dev Patel
